name: firecrawl-run
description: Run one of Firecrawl's declared operations. Destructive rows are marked in the description — confirm with the user before running one.

command.description: firecrawl.workflow.run — Run workflow; firecrawl.workflow.duplicate — Duplicate; firecrawl.workflow.export — Export as JSON; firecrawl.workflow.delete — Delete workflow (destructive); firecrawl.step.move-up — Move up; firecrawl.step.move-down — Move down; firecrawl.step.duplicate — Duplicate step; firecrawl.step.delete — Delete step (destructive); firecrawl.dataset.view — Open in Data view; firecrawl.dataset.export-json — Export as JSON; firecrawl.dataset.export-md — Export as Markdown; firecrawl.dataset.export-csv — Export as CSV; firecrawl.dataset.copy — Copy contents; firecrawl.dataset.delete — Delete dataset (destructive); firecrawl.new-workflow — New workflow; firecrawl.example — Add example workflow; firecrawl.refresh — Refresh from disk

data.description: Context the row would have carried — the item, list or selection the command acts on.
